finding_summary: WP807 validates success_count only as 0 <= success_count <= sample_count.
The current verdict path does not gate on success_count or terminal completion evidence.

A deterministic witness with four ACCEPTED capabilities, shared holdout id, distinct receipt/reconciliation identities, sample_count=10, success_count=0, baseline_score_ppm=100000 and intervention_score_ppm=900000 satisfies the current score/sample predicates and yields SUPPORTED_AT_COMPONENT_SCOPE under the copied exact acceptance semantics.
This falsifies the assumption that WP807 itself enforces score/success consistency; it does not establish that upstream WP802-WP805 producers emit inconsistent scores.
execution_limit: Private repo source could not be directly imported into the local execution container through the available raw-download boundary. E3 is therefore an exact-source semantic witness using the bound acceptance predicates, not byte-for-byte module execution and not F2 runtime evidence.
counterhypothesis: Upstream accepted producers may prove an invariant tying score_ppm to success_count. Trace those producer contracts before deciding whether WP807 must recompute scores or merely bind their derivation identities.
recommended_gate: Before supported WP807 verdicts can be used as evidence of completed capability, require producer-bound/recomputed score derivation and explicit completion/success consistency; preserve component-only authority.
mirror_policy: Provenance mirror only. F2 owns the claim mutex and canonical result.
